title: RateCard
description: ArchResidenceBD rate card v0.1.0 (plan §6 - BOQ cost types; §5.10 - provenance) - one region/date/source set of market rates. Cards are the market side: the price service (W2.7) pushes card values into the Building Spec's inline pricing (Pricing/MaterialRate/LabourRate/MachineryRate/SubcontractRate), where per-project overrides then live in the Deviation Register as usual. status=candidate marks unverified content (plan §9) - candidate cards are never used silently. Real cards are user-imported or registry-fetched; spec/examples/interfaces carries an illustrative one.

region.description: Base region whose price level the lines represent, e.g. dhaka, chattogram, khulna, rajshahi, sylhet, barishal, rangpur, mymensingh.

status.description: candidate = not yet verified against its source (never used in a BOQ without acknowledgement); active = verified/current; archived = superseded.

asOf.description: Observation date of the price list; absent when the source carries its own retrievedAt only.

^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$.description: Factor applied to rateBdt for that region; the card's own region = 1.0 by definition and is not listed.

regionalMultipliers.description: Card-level regional multipliers (plan §6). A line may override with its own map.

kind.description: Where the numbers come from. official_list = published list (e.g. mill/govt price list); market_survey = our/engineer survey; vendor_quote = a supplier quote; user_input = typed by the user; manual = maintained by hand (illustrative examples use this).

name.description: Human-readable source name, e.g. 'Cement mill list 2026-10'.

sha256.description: Hash of the fetched artifact (list PDF/CSV) when one exists - provenance per plan §5.10.

costType.description: Plan §6 cost types. Drives BOQ column grouping.

unit.description: Canonical unit vocabulary (free string, documented): material - bag, ton, kg, cum, cft, sqm, sft, m, ft, litre, each, roll; labour - day, point, sqm, cum, per_unit; machinery - hour, day; subcontract - per_pile, per_ft, machine_hour, per_sqm, per_unit, lump_sum.

operatorIncluded.description: Machinery lines only: true when the rate includes the operator (plan §6 inclusion flags).

fuelIncluded.description: Machinery lines only: true when the rate includes fuel.

minimumChargeHours.description: Machinery lines only: minimum billable hours per mobilization, when the source states one.

regionalMultipliers.description: Per-line override of the card-level multipliers (e.g. piling is priced nationally).
